title: Child and Dependent Care Credit - basics
facts: The federal Child and Dependent Care Credit can help eligible taxpayers with qualifying care expenses paid so they can work or look for work.
Qualifying-person rules can include a dependent child under age 13 and certain spouses or dependents incapable of self-care, subject to tax-law requirements.
The credit is based on eligible expenses and earned-income rules and is distinct from the Child Tax Credit.
Employer dependent-care benefits and other reimbursements can affect the expenses eligible for the credit.
